1. Notification of repurchase offer. This notice is given to the shareholders of the fund.
The registrant states the facts for this section in the filing body.

2. Repurchase offer terms. The fund offers to repurchase up to five percent of its outstanding shares.
The registrant states the facts for this section in the filing body.

3. Repurchase request deadline. Requests must be received in good order by the date stated in this notice.
The registrant states the facts for this section in the filing body.

4. Repurchase pricing date. Shares accepted for repurchase will be priced at net asset value on that date.
The registrant states the facts for this section in the filing body.

5. Signatures. Signed by the officers of the fund whose names appear in this notice.
The registrant states the facts for this section in the filing body.
